title: Continual Learning Mechanisms Compose for Long-Horizon Memorization
abstract: arXiv:2609.06986v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models may need to internalize information that arrives over time and retain it through many subsequent updates. To study this challenge, we introduce long-horizon memorization, a setting in which a model learns 100 query-answer tasks through continual supervised fine-tuning without retaining earlier training examples or receiving task identifiers at inference. Sequential updates cause catastrophic forgetting, and no single continual learning mechanism we evaluate maintains strong retention at this horizon. We hypothesize that mechanisms addressing complementary sources of forgetting will be more effective when composed. We organize these compositions along two design dimensions. Data, function, and weight anchors specify what prior information each update should preserve, while low-rank allocation rules determine where successive updates are retained. translated_title: 持续学习机制组合实现长时程记忆
translated_abstract: 语言模型可能需要内化随时间不断到达的信息，并在后续多次更新中将其保留。为了研究这一挑战，我们提出了长时程记忆这一设置：模型通过持续监督微调学习100个问答任务，且不保留早期训练样本，推理时也不接收任务标识符。顺序更新会导致灾难性遗忘，而我们评估的任何单一持续学习机制都无法在此时间跨度上保持良好的记忆保留。我们假设，针对互补性遗忘来源的机制在组合使用时会更加有效。我们沿两个设计维度组织这些组合：数据、函数和权重锚点规定了每次更新应保留哪些先验信息，而低秩分配规则则决定了连续更新被保留的位置。为了系统地检验这一假设，我们构建了三个不同的100任务
tldr: 该论文提出长时程记忆设置，发现任何单一持续学习机制都无法在100个连续任务的顺序学习中避免灾难性遗忘，而通过组合解决互补遗忘来源的机制（数据/函数/权重锚点与低秩分配规则）可以实现有效的长期记忆保留。
